key.name: stations
key.description: JSON array of objects with "name", "url" and optionally "uuid" (radio-browser.info id) and "favicon".

key.name: custom-stations
key.description: JSON array of objects with "name", "url" and optionally "favicon" (web address or file:// URI of the logo).

key.name: show-title-in-panel
key.summary: Show the station or song title next to the panel icon

key.name: notify-title-change
key.summary: Show a notification when the song changes

key.name: report-plays
key.summary: Tell radio-browser.info which of its stations are played
key.description: radio-browser.info uses these reports to rank the most popular stations. Off unless the user turns it on.

key.name: country-code
key.summary: Country for popular stations (ISO code such as ES). Empty means the system language country.
